verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere ships inference engines (on-device SDK, MetalRT) and a hosted OpenAI-compatible inference API, so serving throughput via continuous batching and chunked prefill is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never mentions continuous batching, chunked prefill, or multi-request serving throughput. The only performance evidence is single-stream tok/s benchmarks and NPU/kernel acceleration, which is a different capability.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can achieve high serving throughput via continuous batching and chunked prefill
